notes.title: Oden Reveal
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36371491/52688cd0a9abcb794b0c9b88338d3413e959f21d.png[/img]


Rattingham studios is proud to announce its new title! 
Discover Oden and immerse yourself in an Open-World Dark Fantasy Action RPG inspired by the places and culture of Sardinia. Can you uncover the truth about the Prophecy of the Paradox and save the fate of Oden?

With significantly improved graphics, [url=https://oden.games/]ODEN[/url] shows the world outside the tower and the consequences of the actions of the corruption that envelops the world.
Follow us on our social networks of [url=https://www.facebook.com/Rattingham-Studios-109874808440885]facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/rattingham_studios/]instagram[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/rattinghams]twitter[/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021620/Oden/]Steam page[/url] will be launched where all the information regarding the game is contained and you can add to the wishlist and stay constantly updated on the development of the game!

Follow the social networks and visit the web page di [url=https://oden.games/]ODEN[/url] for any information on this next title.

Stay tuned for the new updates! May the Janas protect you!

notes.title: Tower of Heresy now available for free
notes.notes:
Hi guys! Today is the big day that TOH will become free to play, looking forward to the new game.

The free to play transition includes a new patch with many graphics and game additions to lengthen the game experience and have greater replayability.

In addition to TOH's free-to-play transition and update, next week there will be the announcement and release of the gameplay trailer for the new game.

We can't wait to show you the our new game and introduce you to the world of Oden!

Stay tuned and may the Janas protect you!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36371491/206f2279a29a9b8a60b92e7c8523df5d9b12c209.png[/img]

notes.title: A new game is coming
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are happy to inform you that finally, after a lot of hard work, Rattingham Studios will be announcing the next title later this week.

The next title, currently in development, will be directly connected to the narrative universe of Tower of Heresy, for which it was decided to make TOH free from the 30th of June to allow the community to play freely, and to show everyone the story prologue of the next title.


In conjunction with this announcement there will also be updates regarding Tower of Heresy, which will include: 

[list]
[*]a re-skin of the icons of weapons, item and some enemies

[*]various balances

[*]additions and rewriting of the descriptions of all the in-game items and equipement

[*]new HUD that shows the stamina bar

[*]new New Game+ that changes all game dialogues and events 
[/list]

We have worked hard with the new members of the Rattingham family to bring this new project to life, and we can't wait to show you and let you explore the world of Tower of Heresy from a new point of view.

Stay tuned for the new update and the announcement of the next title. May the Janas protect you!

notes.title: Warpeds Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Some bugs related to warpeds in some areas have been fixed. Now the entrances to secret areas and the entrance to the Forgotten Archives work, allowing the passage of the player in the respective playing areas.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: New Patch - Movement Change
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce a major gameplay change that will improve your approach to the game.
New update that greatly improves the movement of the character.
From now on the character will have the movement in pixels and no more in squares, and for this some spells and weapons hitboxes have been fixed.

[previewyoutube=OXNY0MFGd1E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[list]
[*]Soul Boom: hitbox shortened by 1
[*]Guardian's Mace: hitbox increased by 1
[*]Infernal Fury: hitbox decreased by 1
[*]The areas before the bosses will now have a fog, and you have to interact to enter.
[*]Damage reduction caused by poisonous puddles.
[*]Judged's Earring accessory now completely negates damage from poisonous puddles.
[*]Increased the resistance of the damage caused by the terrain of the armor: Executioner Mantle.
[*]Various changes in the environment.
[/list]

This update is not present in the Demo version.
Thanks to everyone, and have fun everyone.

notes.title: New Content Awaits You!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=30sZxkATz3Y;full][/previewyoutube]


Hello everyone!
We are happy to announce the completion of the additional area called: Forgotten Path.

In this area accessible after the story is complete, 6 new areas will be available to explore, with 6 new bosses to defeat.
Inside there will also be new equipment: including armor, weapons, rings and accessories to improve your builds and create new challenges!

Many aspects of the game have also been fixed with this update to make the adventure much more engaging and enjoyable.

Have fun!




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36371491/c8df5ea325c4832a9c72dec85b5f5b983af98227.png[/img]

notes.title: New Weapon Upgrade System.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In these days tests have been carried out for the balance of the game, and correction of some bugs.
it was decided to add a new feature and slightly change the enchantments of weapons and their improvement.

In this regard, enemy drop rates have been added, to meet precisely this change.

Weapons can now be improved by combining Emeralds, Crystals, and Sapphires with weapons, through the new feature in the inventory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36371491/946752229b674cab0521defb259766376f8d0aab.png[/img]

The weapons, according to the modifier will require different objects in addition to the aforementioned materials, which will be: Steel and Diamond for physical weapons, Soul Fragments and Soul Globes for Arcane weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36371491/d828d282f7b2b9293eff7459b90c5767661db7c5.png[/img]

Weapons upgraded in this way will gain extra damage and sometimes an improvement in the modifier, or additional effects.

The Shadow Gem, Sphere of Spirit and Bone of Fury items will serve to improve weapons with Alpha modifier.

We apologize for the inconvenience that this update could create for players who have already played the game, but this new feature greatly improves the game experience.

Thank you so much for your attention and I wish you lots of fun!

notes.title: Gem Fix patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Balances were made within the game, which led to the change in enchantments and the number of slots on the equipment.

[list]

[*]Emerald, Crystal and Sapphire now increase the Focus stat.

[*]Danmat's Horn, Dragon Scales, and Demon Tooth now increase maximum LPs.

[*]Ancient Page and Old Seal now increase maximum APs.
[/list]
Thanks for your attention, enjoy everyone!

notes.title: New Two Dungeon, Boss and More!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we are happy to announce a new update that includes two unlockable dangions in End-Game, new armor, new weapons and a new feature useful for anyone who uses ranged weapons.


Now you can block the direction of the character by holding down "Space" or "Z", allowing you to face enemies more easily if you intend to approach them with ranged weapons.

In addition, there are 9 new unlockable equipment in the new End-game maps, 1 weapon per class and 3 pieces of armor that can be combined together, plus useful accessories to form new combinations.
In the new maps there are two new Bosses that will test your skills and your builds.

Thanks everyone, have fun.

notes.title: New menu update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are happy to announce a new update that will improve the gaming experience.
The equipment menu now shows only useful stats: Life points, Arcane Points, Strength, Arcane, Agility, Accuracy, Evasion, Critical, Stamina Regeneration.
In addition, some balances have been made on armor and weapons.

Change:

[list]
[*]Eliminated Focus and Spirit stats in various armor.
[*]Eliminate the Focus stat in the El legendaria el Bastardos weapon.
[*]The EX-Parameters are visible in the equipment menu.
[*]Added in the Dream armor set up + 7% critical total.
[*]Changed the Ring of Spirit to the Alchemist's Ring which adds + 10% potency to potions.[/list]


Have fun, we're preparing high end dungeons!

notes.title: Changing system requirements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

After being reported by a user regarding requests for system requirements, we did our best to make further tests for the game's performance.
We want to inform users that after the tests carried out we changed the recommended and minimum requirements required by the game, noting that the previous requirements used were actually too high.

We apologize for the previous information, which perhaps made the purchase of the product desist, but we wanted you all to have a smooth gaming experience.

We apologize again for the inconvenience caused by the previous system requirements.

Have fun, the team remains at your disposal to answer any requests!

notes.title: If you want to use the joypad?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm working on the integration of the pad instead of the keyboard, in order to make the game more accessible for those who are not confortable using the keyboard.
In the meantime, to remedy the "problem" of the keyboard, you can use a free external software that emulates on your pad the keyboard keys called: [b]JoyToKey[/b].
With this program you can quickly and easily set the keyboard keys on your pad and put them as you like.

The number of game keys to use perfectly match the number of keys of any latest generation pad, giving the possibility to customize your controller as you wish.
Here you can find the link to the site where you can download the software.

Thanks everyone, have fun!

[url=https://joytokey.net/en/download]Download JoyToKey[/url]

notes.title: I don't need to level up!
notes.notes:
Let's starts with a new challenge to win a free Tower of Heresy Key, this time it is a challenge for the bravest.
Inside the game there is a particular weapon that does not allow the acquisition of experience, allowing you to make a challenge by keeping your character at level 1.

Participating and winning is very simple: [b]don't level up, find the "Challange Sword" in the tutorial map, equip it, end the game demo with the sword equipped, upload your adventure on youtube in full without cuts, mail the video on any social game, Facebook, Steam, Itch or Gamejolt.[/b]

The first 3 who have finished in the shortest time and with the least number of deaths will win a key of the complete game to be redeemed on Steam, where you can also import the save data of your challenge to continue it.

If you want to demonstrate your gamer value, this is the challenge for you!

[url=https://towerofheresy.itch.io/tower-of-heresy]Download the Demo Here![/url]

notes.title: I'm a SpeedRunner!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! ːsteamhappyː

There will be three challenges these days before the release of the game, which will reward the most hardcore players with free keys.

The challenges will end on [b]January 5th[/b], where the winners will be drawn.

The first of the three challenges is to finish the Tower of Heresy demo as quickly as possible, the first three that will end in the shortest time will receive a key of the complete game redeemable on Steam.

To take part in the challenge, just post a screenshot of the credits on the Facebook page or in the Steam community, with the corresponding time using the "LiveSplit" app. (I will leave a tutorial link explaining how to install the app and where to download it.) The rooms and the finish line must be labeled: [b]Tutorial, first Boss, Altar of Fate, Dimensional chambers, Final credits (the end)[/b].

Use of the game's internal timer will not be valid to win the challenge.
The other two challenges will be published shortly.

Good luck to everyone, I await your results.

[b]Tutorial[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xq2MCodtH34]LiveSplit App[/url]

[b]You can find the Demo here[/b]: [url=https://towerofheresy.itch.io/tower-of-heresy]Game Demo[/url]
